shop_privacy.title: Kit orders and help choosing
shop_privacy.text: When you submit a request, we store your name, phone number, selected kits and their prices, and the city, code and address of your chosen CDEK pickup point. Telegram and comments are stored only if provided. GrowerHub administrators use these details to respond, check the kit and agree the order and delivery with you. The administrator's Telegram notification includes only the request number, total and a link to the protected order page. Contacts, addresses and form text are excluded from analytics and Webvisor form recording. A request key and a hash of the network address help prevent duplicates and abuse. Submitting a request does not subscribe you to marketing messages. Contact the operator to correct or delete your information.

shop_terms.title: Kit requests
shop_terms.text: An order placed on this website is a request for a kit to be assembled after confirmation. There is no online payment: we contact you first, check the kit and device compatibility, then agree payment, delivery cost and timing. Shipping is separate from the kit price. Find a CDEK pickup point yourself and enter its code and address. The kit includes a hub, the stated number of smart plugs, a power supply and cable, checks and help with the first connection; lamps are not included. Illustrations show the contents; the supplied units may look different. Mini POK101 and the specific smart plug revision must be checked before we confirm supply. GrowerHub schedules require internet access; these kits are not intended to operate watering equipment.

pushok_privacy.title: PushOk cloud connection
pushok_privacy.text: After your confirmation and physical pairing, GrowerHub uses the PushOk cloud to receive the hub's device list, names, readings and states, and can send commands. A separate access key is created; this key and the server MQTT bridge password are stored encrypted in the database and are not sent to web analytics. GrowerHub does not request your home Wi-Fi password or an access export from Upravlyator. Archiving the connection stops communication and deletes the saved server keys; collected history remains in your account. You can remove the separate hub user in Upravlyator. Communication depends on internet access and PushOk cloud availability.

pilot_privacy.title: Pilot connection requests
pilot_privacy.text: At your request, we store your preferred contact method, contact details, optional equipment description and request date in your account. You and GrowerHub administrators can access this information to discuss the pilot and help with setup; it is not sent in web analytics events. In connection settings, open “PushOk help and my request”, then “Withdraw request” to remove the request and contact details. They are also removed when your account is deleted.

demo_privacy.title: Demo farm and sessions
demo_privacy.text: A guest demo farm stores virtual devices, settings and history for 24 hours. Access uses a separate protected session cookie; a hash of the network address limits how often farms can be created. Simulation pauses after 10 minutes of inactivity. A demo saved to an account remains until reset, replacement or account deletion. Demo access does not grant access to the account's real devices.

demo_terms.title: Demonstration mode
demo_terms.text: Sensor readings, water use and electricity use in the demo farm are simulated. They let you try the interface and scenarios but do not confirm compatibility with specific equipment. Guest farms are deleted after expiry; save your demo to an account to continue later.
